tools.name: url_to_markdown
tools.description: Fetch a public web page and return clean Markdown (title, main text, links). Input: {url}. Costs $0.002 USDC (Solana, x402).

tools.name: summarize
tools.description: Summarize text or a web page URL into concise bullet points (LLM, Llama 3.1 8B fp8). Input: {text} or {url}, optional {max_words}. Costs $0.003 USDC (Solana, x402).

tools.name: site_contacts
tools.description: Company/website enrichment: crawl a domain's homepage plus contact/about pages and return public emails, phone numbers, social profiles (X, LinkedIn, GitHub, etc.), page title/description and detected tech. Input: {url} or {domain}. Costs $0.005 USDC (Solana, x402).

tools.name: solana_token_check
tools.description: Solana SPL token snapshot + rug-risk flags: name/symbol, supply, decimals, USD price (when indexed), mint & freeze authority status, top-10 holder concentration, token program. Input: {mint}. Costs $0.003 USDC (Solana, x402).
